`synthetic-commentary.wav` was generated locally using Windows System.Speech for integration testing. It contains two short English commentary passages spoken at different rates. It is a test signal, not a recording of a real sporting event.

Spoken text:

> The game begins quietly. The players are moving slowly across the field. We are waiting for the next chance. Here they come, racing forward! What a wonderful pass! The crowd is cheering! He shoots and scores! An incredible finish to the game!

The transcript model is actually run on this waveform in the opt-in test; no scores or recognized words are substituted.
